# Oneway OS, every page in words

> The words of every page of Oneway OS on onewayos.com, read on 2026-10-20 from the pages themselves (tools/landing_static.py).

Oneway is a social network and a business platform in one: the Oneway App gives every person one profile, a For You feed, messages and a map of the people and places near them, and Oneway OS runs the businesses, communities and places behind them. It is in a closed beta, by invitation, in New York City and Long Island. Oneway, the Oneway App and Oneway OS are made only by Oneway Technologies LLC, of New York. We are not affiliated with oneway.tools, with the Oneway retail and self-checkout software at tryoneway.com, with the One Way services app, or with any other product that uses the name Oneway.

The Center Model

The Center is the canvas. Oneway OS is the brush.

A Center can be an information page .

However you choose to use Oneway OS, the Center model creates opportunities for communities, businesses, and organizations to connect, grow, and strengthen the places they bring together.

Free

Oneway OS

Create a Center for your community, your business's public page or an information page about a place.

Open Oneway OS →

Free

Developer OS

Build apps, modules and integrations that Centers can use.

Explore Developer OS →

Oneway OS runs a business, a community or a place: its page, website, posts, events and members for free, and with Business OS, the Systems of its industry, its team and the Brain.

Business OS

Run your whole operation from one Center.

Core

For one Center's team

$39.99 a month

The whole Brain on your Center: it notices, answers, drafts and recommends

Assets, bookings, staff and customers on one record

The Systems for your kind of place

Lightbulb and the website creator, inside a monthly allowance

You approve every action

Business

For one business Center

$330 a month

Everything in Core, plus:

The Brain can act for you, within the limits you set

Helpers and plans that keep running on their own

A much larger thinking allowance

Business OS adds the Brain, the Systems for your industry and your team's tools to a Center. It is set up with you by contact, and several Centers or Enterprise OS are by contact too.

Talk to us → Explore Business OS →

Oneway Brain

The Brain sits under your Center. It connects the platforms and tools you already use, notices what needs attention, answers your questions and drafts the next step.

On Core and Business.

Oneway Systems

Add Systems for your industry and your everyday work: customers, inventory, equipment, maintenance, scheduling, bookings and more.

See every System →

Every Center has a page

Every Center has a public page.

It's what people see when they find you on the map, in search or in a friend's feed, in the Oneway App and on the web.

Your layout Arrange your page your way with Popits: your info, posts, events, offers, photos and more.

Works like a profile Post updates, get followers and messages. Your followers and members are real people with their own Profiles.

Your content Posts, events, offers, photos and hours, kept up to date in one place.

Your community Members, groups, chat and events for the people around your place.

Your website too The same page can be your website, on your own domain.

Run from Oneway OS Your team runs the Center in Oneway OS, and what you change there shows on your page right away.

Business OS vs. the stack

Seven apps, or one Center.

7 separate apps, or one Center on one login

Most businesses run on a pile of separate tools that never talk to each other. Business OS puts them in one Center, on one login.

Instead of On Business OS

A website builder Wix, Squarespace Your Center itself, as its website

A booking app Calendly, OpenTable Bookings and reservations, in the same Center people follow

An online store Shopify, Square Online A shop beside everything else the place does

A customer list HubSpot, Mailchimp Customers kept from every visit, order and message

A social media scheduler Hootsuite, Later Posts that go to the platforms you connect, from one place

A team chat and staff app Slack, Homebase Staff, roles and every message in one inbox

A link-in-bio page Linktree One Center that people follow, with everything on it

Add up your own stack: tick each tool you pay for and type what it costs you a month.

Your stack: $0 a month

Your stack costs a month more than Business OS.

Your numbers stay in your browser.

The names are examples of each kind of tool, and none of them has any affiliation with Oneway.

## Business OS for Entertainment & Venues

Source: https://onewayos.com/os-business-entertainment

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Entertainment & Venues
Business OS

Entertainment & Venues.

Events with Going and Maybe, the people who come, the door on the night, and the work behind it.

Talk to us

Events

Found, answered and counted.

The Oneway App, with a sample Center.

People find the event on the Center's page in the Oneway App, say Going, Maybe or Not going, and see how many are going.

A draft until it is out
A draft is the team's alone until it is published. A cancelled event stays on the page and says so.

Spaces to book
A room, a court or a lane booked from the App. Where the venue confirms each booking, the guest is told it is a request before sending it.

System Store: Events and Reservations.

The door

Who is here, of who is coming.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

At the door the team sees the next events, how many are here of how many are coming, and checks each guest in with one press, or undoes it.

The people who come

Who follows, who has joined, who is going.

The Center's followers see its posts in their feeds, its members have joined it, and each event knows who is going.

The work

The work behind every night.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

Work orders on the venue's own things, in the order to do them.

Requests
Staff, members and guests with a booking report a problem, and Maintenance takes it on as a work order or declines it, saying why.

Inspections
A checklist the venue writes, run on a stage, a room or the whole place. An item that fails opens its own repair.

Preventive work
Upkeep that recurs opens its own work order before it is due.

Vendors
Work sent to a contractor, and what they said and what it cost when it came back.

Shifts
Each night's crew clocks in from their Workspace, and before payroll a manager fixes or excuses every late start and missed shift.

System Store: Maintenance, Asset Management and Scheduling.

Run your venue on Oneway OS.

## Business OS for Hospitality

Source: https://onewayos.com/os-business-hospitality

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Hospitality
Business OS

Hospitality.

Hotel operations, the guest's experience and the front office, in one Center.

Talk to us

Hotel Operations

The book, from the rate to the room.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

A hotel sells a room type, for a night, at a rate. The book keeps all three, and what is left to sell on every date.

Rooms and rates
Room types, rate plans and what is left to sell, by type and by date.

Holds and moves
A room taken out of sale for dates, with its reason, and a guest moved to another room in the house or before they arrive.

Group blocks
Rooms held for a group until its cut-off date, and the pick-up as its guests book.

Deposits and the city ledger
Deposits recorded as guests put them down, and the house accounts billed instead of the guest. Oneway records money and never moves it.

Pace
The nights ahead on the books, how fast they are coming in, and where last year stood at the same time.

Housekeeping and upkeep
A cleaned room sells only once a supervisor has inspected it. Upkeep follows use too, such as a boiler's run hours or an elevator's trips.

System Store: Hotel Operations, with Maintenance and Asset Management.

Guest Experience

Every guest, known across the property.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

What each department needs to know about a stay, the guest's own messages, and a program that rewards them for coming back.

Traces
A note about a guest's stay, for a department, on a day. The department sees it in its Workspace that day and marks it done.

Rewards
The hotel's own program: a tier earned within the program year is kept through the next, and the credits a guest spends lapse after months without activity. At a casino resort, the casino's own system keeps the points.

One inbox
Guests' messages arrive in the Center's one inbox.

A problem, reported once
A guest reports a problem in their room from the Oneway App, during the stay or up to 30 days after it. If the room already has work open, the report joins it, and the guest is told when it is fixed.

System Store: Rewards & Membership and Maintenance, beside Hotel Operations.

Front Office

The desk's day, and the numbers.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

Arrivals, the guests in the house and the ones leaving today, the night audit, and the figures every hotelier judges a property by.

The board
Who arrives, who is in the house and who is due out, with each room's state.

Check-in and the folio
The stay begins, the room becomes occupied, and a deposit held meets the folio every charge lands on.

The night audit
Each night's room charges and taxes posted to the folio, by the rules the property names.

The numbers
Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR from what the audit posted, beside the same night last year.

Charges to post
A check charged to a room by a connected point of sale waits for the desk, which posts it in one press. Nothing posts by itself.

The book you have today
A reservations export from the hotel system you use now, or a spreadsheet, brought in as this hotel's stays.

System Store: Reservations, with Hotel Operations.

Additional Hospitality Systems

The property's other systems, one intake.

What the hotel system, the points of sale, housekeeping and the valet report becomes one Center's events, one guest's timeline, and work for the person on shift.

One system at a time
Each is connected on its own, in Oneway OS's Integrations, and a system nobody has connected says exactly that.

One guest, on evidence
Two systems' guests are one guest only when the same card, the same address or the system's own guest id arrives from both. A name alone joins nothing.

Casino resorts
Oneway runs beside the casino management system. It reads it, writes nothing to it, and keeps no gaming money.

The casino's own day
The hosts' book of guests and their trips, the floor by area, and the pit's dealer rotation.

System Store: Casino Operations.

Run your property on Oneway OS.

## Business OS for Additional Industries

Source: https://onewayos.com/os-business-industries

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Additional Industries
Business OS

Additional Industries.

Rental property, and every kind of place a Center can be.

Talk to us

Rental property

The rent roll, unit by unit.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

Every unit leased, on notice or vacant, what is owed past its due date, and the leases coming to an end.

Units
Each unit named as the building names it, with its bedrooms and its asking rent.

Leases
The tenant, the rent, the deposit and the term: in force, on notice or ended. Two leases never overlap on one unit.

Statements
Each lease's rent, fees and credits, and the payments recorded against them. Oneway collects no rent.

Past due
What is owed, oldest first, aged 1⁠–⁠30, 31⁠–⁠60, 61⁠–⁠90 and over 90 days.

Renewals
The leases ending within 90 days, each renewed from where it shows.

Move-in and move-out
A checklist walked at each end of a lease. Once both are done, every item sound at move-in that failed at move-out is named, with both notes.

The owner's statement
A month of the property as its owner reads it: for each unit, what was charged and what was collected.

System Store: Property Management, with Maintenance for the work orders.

Every kind of place

A Center for every kind of place.

$0 Community Management, on Oneway OS

Museums and galleries, schools and clubs, churches and nonprofits, festivals, neighborhoods and cities.

A Center that is not a business
A community, a club, a festival or a city runs on the free Oneway OS and needs no Business OS.

Members
People join a Center's community from the Oneway App.

Events
What is on at the place, answered in the App.

System Store: Community Management, free on Oneway OS. Events, Reservations and Scheduling come with Business OS.

Give your place a Center.

## Business OS for Restaurants

Source: https://onewayos.com/os-business-restaurants

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Restaurants
Business OS

Restaurants.

The floor and the kitchen, run from Oneway OS.

Talk to us

The floor

Every table, and who is at it.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

The host sees each table with its seats and its section, the party at it, and how long they have been there.

Tables and sections
Each table is one of the restaurant's own things: its number, its seats and its section.

Every seating
A walk-in, a party from the waitlist or a booking that has arrived, seated and then cleared for the next party.

Bookings due
The bookings due at your tables over the next twelve hours, each seated in one press.

Turn times
The day's turn times, with its covers and its parties.

The table that fits
For a party waiting, the floor names an open table that seats them and is not held for a booking before they would leave. The host still chooses.

Returning guests
A guest who has let places recognize them is named as returning, at the table and in the line.

System Store: Restaurant Operations, with Reservations for the bookings.

The waitlist

The line, on the guest's phone too.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

Who is waiting, how many, the quote they were given and how long they have waited, and which parties are past their quote.

Join from the App
A guest joins the waitlist from the restaurant's page in the Oneway App and follows their own place in line.

Ready
When the host says a table is ready, a guest who joined from the App is told there at once. Anyone else, the host calls.

The kitchen

The 86 board.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

What the kitchen is out of today, who said so and when, and back on with one press.

Point of sale

Your point of sale stays.

Once it is connected, a check opened or closed at a table shows on the floor. Oneway takes no payment.

Of a closed check, Oneway keeps its totals, and never the tips, the payment or what was ordered.

System Store

Add what the restaurant needs.

5 Systems a restaurant starts with

A restaurant can start with these five.

Restaurant Operations
The floor, the waitlist and the 86 board.

Reservations
A party books a table from the Oneway App for as many as it seats, and a time already taken says when the table is next free.

Scheduling
Shifts for the floor and the kitchen, flagged when one would leave someone less than eight hours' rest or take their week past 40 hours. Someone who cannot work a shift offers it, and a manager approves whoever takes it.

Maintenance
Repairs on the kitchen's own equipment, and when one piece keeps breaking, its failures read as one incident with what fixed it last time.

Rewards & Membership
A diner's card, opened by their member number, with what they spend on dining posted to it and credits redeemed from it.

Run your restaurant on Oneway OS.

Oneway Business OS.

The full business operating system: the Brain, Systems, Agents, Cross Projection and operational intelligence.

Talk to us Oneway OS

Industries

Start with your industry.

Oneway OS, with sample records.

Each page shows what Business OS runs for that kind of place, and the Systems it starts with.

Restaurants
Seating the floor, a waitlist guests follow on their phones, and what the kitchen has run out of.

Hospitality
Rooms sold by type and rate, the front desk through its night audit, and casino resorts beside their own systems.

Entertainment & Venues
Who is coming to each event, checking them in as they arrive, and keeping the venue in repair.

Additional Industries
Leases and what tenants owe, for rental property, and a Center for a museum, a school, a club or a city.

What it carries

The business layer of a Center.

$330 a month for one Center on Business OS

Everything a free Center has, and the parts a business runs on.

Systems
Each industry's tools, picked in the System Store and installed into the Center.

The Brain
The memory of the whole operation.

Cross Projection
Where the business's own website or its map entry shows other hours or another phone number than its record, the Brain sets the two side by side for someone to choose. The choice is written once, and every page that reads the record shows it.

Agents
Not built yet.

Bring your business to Oneway OS.

## Oneway Asset Management

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/asset-management

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Asset Management
Core System

Asset Management.

Asset Management tracks everything your business owns: where it is, who has it, what it cost, and when it needs service.

Replaces Asset Panda or Snipe-IT.

Plus what they can't do, because it's connected to the rest of your business.

Any kind of asset
Track anything your business owns, from hotel rooms and slot machines to vans and equipment at a customer's home.

Set up with your industry System
Turn on Hotel Operations and Asset Management, Reservations and Maintenance come with it.

Parts tracked to each machine
See which parts are installed in each piece of equipment, and when they were swapped out.

The base every physical System runs on: Hotel Operations, Restaurant Operations, Property Management, HVAC and more.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta.

Talk to us

Asset Management in Oneway OS, with sample records.

The register

Everything you own, in one list.

One asset list
Search by name, tag, code, type, location or status, and edit many at once.

Locations
Nest locations and assets inside each other. Move one and everything inside it moves too.

QR codes
Print a QR label for each asset. Scanning it opens the asset in Oneway OS.

Check-out and return
Check an asset out to someone until a due date, and record its condition when it comes back.

Purchases and warranties
Price, supplier, warranty and expected life, with a list of warranties ending in the next 90 days.

Audits
Walk through each location and see what's missing.

Custom groups
Make your own groups, with counts, and search, add and report by group.

Retiring assets
A second person approves each retirement, and the asset's history is kept.

Reports, a map of every asset by location, and each department's work.

Maintenance

Keep it running and know the cost.

Work orders
Assigned to whoever is on shift with the fewest open jobs, and sent to their phone.

Closed with proof
Parts, cost, hours and photos of the fix are saved on the asset.

Past fixes
The next tech sees what fixed it last time, with photos.

Preventive maintenance
Scheduled by days or by meter readings, with on-time, late and overdue tracking.

Problem reports
Guests, members and staff report problems from the App and hear back when it's fixed.

Sensor readings
Meter readings can come straight from the equipment's sensors.

Cost and condition

Know when to repair or replace.

Condition and status
Track whether it's working, degraded or failed, and whether it's in service. An out-of-order item comes off what you can sell.

Downtime
Hours down in the last 90 days and in total.

Reliability
Average time between failures and to repair, plus your least reliable assets.

Cost of ownership
Purchase price plus every repair, current book value, and when it's worth replacing.

Change history
Every change, with who made it, when and why.

Scheduled reports
Reports sent to owners on a schedule, and your asset list as a spreadsheet.

How it works

From purchase to replacement.

Add it
Manually, from a spreadsheet or by QR label.

Use it
Book it, lend it, sell it or repair it.

Maintain it
Work orders and preventive maintenance.

Know its cost
Downtime, repair costs and when to replace it.

Who it is for

For any business with equipment.

Hotels and resorts
Rooms, elevators, kitchens and mechanical systems.

Venues and casinos
Slot machines, tables and the floor.

Property managers
Units and the appliances in them.

Gyms, schools and offices
Equipment, rooms and vehicles.

Comes with these Systems

Casino Operations System
Oneway Events
Oneway Hotel Operations
Oneway Inventory Management
Oneway Maintenance
Property Management System
Restaurant Operations System

At a glance

Oneway Asset Management, in facts.

What it is Asset Management tracks everything your business owns: where it is, who has it, what it cost, and when it needs service.
Part of Oneway OS, as a core system of Business OS.
Comes with Casino Operations System, Events, Hotel Operations System, Inventory Management, Maintenance, Property Management System, Restaurant Operations System.
Where it runs In Oneway OS, in a web browser on a computer or a phone.
Price Part of Business OS, set up by contact. See its plan ; Oneway OS alone is free.
Status In the Closed Selective Server Beta, by invitation, in New York City and Long Island.
Made by Oneway Technologies LLC, New York.

## Oneway Communications

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/communications

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Communications
Module

Communications.

Oneway Communications puts every message to your business in one shared inbox, answers the routine ones by rule, and tells your team what it needs to know.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Communications in Oneway OS, with sample records.

The inbox

One shared inbox.

One shared inbox
Every message people send your business in the Oneway App.

Assignments
Assign a conversation to someone, escalate it with a reason, and close it with the outcome.

Saved replies
Your own saved answers, one click away.

Automatic replies
A greeting, an away message and answers to common questions, sent automatically by your rules.

Other channels
SMS, WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Messenger in the same inbox.
Planned

Translation
Read and reply in the guest's language.
Planned

Team notes, and who read them.

The team

Keep your team informed.

Tell the team
Send a note to everyone or one department, and see who got it.

Shows up in their day
When a conversation is assigned to someone, it shows up in their day in the Oneway App.

Message all in-house guests
One message to everyone staying, or to a group.
Planned

Scheduled guest messages
Messages before arrival, during and after a stay, sent on schedule.
Planned

The difference

See who you're talking to.

Most inbox tools only show messages. Oneway shows each customer's bookings and history right next to the conversation.

Customer info alongside
See who's writing and what they've booked, next to their message.

Your rules, your words
Automatic replies only say what you wrote.

One team
Assign conversations to the people on your team.

How it works

From a message to an answer.

A message comes in
To one inbox, from the App.

Common questions are answered
Automatically, by your rules.

The rest is assigned
To a person, who's notified.

It's closed
With the outcome saved.

Who it is for

For any business customers message.

Hotels
Guests before, during and after a stay.

Restaurants
Bookings, questions and parties.

Venues
Tickets, guest lists and event-night questions.

Communities
Members and their questions.

At a glance

Oneway Communications, in facts.

What it is Oneway Communications puts every message to your business in one shared inbox, answers the routine ones by rule, and tells your team what it needs to know.

## Oneway CRM

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/crm

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Oneway CRM
Core System

Oneway CRM.

Oneway CRM keeps a profile for every customer, with their bookings, orders and messages already filled in, so your team knows who they are and what to do next.

Replaces HubSpot or Pipedrive.

Plus what they can't do, because it's connected to the rest of your business.

No data entry
Bookings, orders, rewards and messages show up on each customer's profile automatically.

One customer list
Web form sign-ups, HVAC calls and online orders all land on the same customer, not separate lists.

Profiles that stay current
Customers on Oneway keep their own name and photo up to date.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Oneway CRM in Oneway OS, with sample records.

The record

Every customer in one place.

Bookings, stays, orders and messages are added to each customer's profile for you, so nobody has to type them in.

Customer timeline
Notes, deals, stays, paid orders, rewards and messages, newest first.

Tags, owners and custom fields
Add your own fields (text, numbers, dates or lists), then filter and export by them.

Contact preferences
Track whether each customer agreed to email, texts and calls. Do-not-contact keeps them out of every campaign and ad audience.

Private by default
Staff only see customers if their role needs them. Nobody outside your business sees anything.

No wrong merges
Two records are only combined when the email or account matches, never just because the names do.

Merge duplicates
Duplicates are found by email, phone or name. An owner merges them and every deal carries over.

Bulk edits
Add a tag, change the owner or mark do-not-contact for many customers at once.

Companies and households
Group people under a company or household, with its own page, deals, follow-ups and timeline.

Automatic tags
Tag regulars, big spenders and guests who haven't been back, based on what they actually did. Updated every hour.

A customer's profile: timeline, deals, follow-ups and contact preferences.

Pipeline

Track every deal from first contact to close.

Name your own stages, run a pipeline for each kind of sale, and set the odds of closing at each stage.

Deals and stages
Lead, qualified, proposal, negotiation, won and lost, with each deal's value and weighted value.

Win and loss reasons
Your win rate over the last 90 days, why deals were lost, and how each salesperson is doing.

Follow-ups
Set a due date and time and assign it to someone. They're notified and see it in their Workspace.

Leads from your bookings
People who booked with you but aren't in your CRM yet, added as customers in one click.

Custom stages and pipelines
Name your stages and run a separate pipeline, with its own board, for each kind of sale.

Reminders
Each follow-up sends its owner one reminder in Notifications when it's due.

Lists and data

Lists, search and data.

Saved lists
Filter by tag, owner, company, stage, contact preference or keyword. Lists update automatically.

Search
Search names, emails, phone numbers, companies, tags and notes.

Import and export
Import a CSV and see exactly which rows didn't load and why. Export any list or filter with every column.

Reports
Pipeline by stage, deals won and lost, and follow-ups open, overdue and done.

Email from the CRM
Email sequences, templates and tracking.
Planned

Web forms
Put a form on its own page or on your website. Each submission becomes a tagged customer with a follow-up.

By email or account, never by guessing.

Their profile updates
Timeline, deals and tags.

## Oneway Hotel Operations

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/hotel-operations

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Hotel Operations
Industry System

Hotel Operations.

Hotel Operations runs a hotel's rooms, rates and guests from one place, from the booking and the front desk to the night audit and housekeeping.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Hotel Operations in Oneway OS, with sample records.

The book

Rooms, rates and reservations.

Reservations
Book by room and dates, and see what's left to sell by room type and night.

Rates
Set rates for each room type, and close a type to sale on chosen dates.

Group blocks
Hold rooms for a group until a cut-off date, then release the rest. Linked to the group's event.

Taxes and terms
The room taxes charged on each stay, and your registration card terms.

Import your reservations
Bring in reservations exported from your current system.

Online travel agencies
Send rooms and rates to booking sites and get bookings back.
Planned

Upcoming nights on the books, and each department's next tasks.

Front desk

Everything the front desk does.

Arrivals and departures
Arrivals, in-house guests and departures, with each room's status.

Check-in, check-out and room moves
Record deposits and move guests to another room before or during their stay.

Charges
Post charges at the desk, or approve charges from the POS with one click.

Night audit
Posts each night's room charges and taxes using your rules.

Key numbers
Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR compared with the same night last year.

Folios and accounts

Folios and billing.

Oneway records payments. It never processes them.

Charge routing
Send a stay's charges to a house account or another folio.

House accounts
Bill with numbered invoices, apply payments to the oldest first, and close them out.

Disputes and write-offs
Each recorded with who did it and why.

Split a bill by payer
Separate sections on one folio for each payer.
Planned

Recurring and batch charges
A charge that repeats, or one charge to many accounts.
Planned

Housekeeping

Housekeeping.

Room status on your phone
Dirty, clean, inspected or ready. A room can only be sold once it's inspected.

Cleaning assignments
Assign rooms to housekeepers on their phones.

Out of order
Take a room off sale with a reason, and put it back when it's fixed.

Traces
Notes for a department about a guest's stay on a certain day, checked off when done.

Guest incidents
Log what happened, to whom and where, and send it to the right department.

Runs on Asset Management

Built on Asset Management.

Hotel Operations has its own screens and tools. Your rooms are tracked as assets, so housekeeping and maintenance work from the same records.

Out of order vs. out of service
Out-of-order rooms come off what you can sell. Out-of-service rooms still count in your room totals.

Comes with what a hotel needs
Reservations, Maintenance and Oneway CRM come with it.

How it works

From booking to night audit.

Booked
A room, dates and a rate.

Checked in
Deposit recorded on the folio.

During the stay
Charges posted, requests handled.

Night audit
The night posted and reports updated.

Who it is for

For hotels of every size.

Independent hotels
Reservations, front desk and accounting in one system.

Resorts
Hotel, restaurants and casino in one place.

Groups of hotels
Each property set up the same way.

Inns and boutique hotels
Fewer rooms, the same tools.

Runs on

Oneway Asset Management

Brings with it

Oneway Reservations
Oneway Maintenance
Oneway CRM

HVAC Service Operations.

Oneway HVAC runs your heating and cooling business from the first call to the finished job: dispatch, your techs' day on their phones, equipment history and service agreements.

Replaces ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro.

Plus what they can't do, because it's connected to the rest of your business.

The right tech, suggested
Oneway suggests the first tech who's on shift and free for the job's time window.

Equipment history at every home
Each customer's units keep their full service history, along with your own trucks and tools.

One customer list
Callers go into the same customer list as your CRM, not a separate one.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

HVAC Service Operations in Oneway OS, with sample records.

Calls and dispatch

Turn every call into a job.

Take a call
Look up a returning customer or add a new one, with their service address.

Job types
Service call, maintenance visit, install or estimate, with the customer's description.

Arrival windows
Set one- to four-hour windows. Move a window and the tech's schedule moves with it.

Dispatch
The tech gets the job on their phone right away, after Oneway checks their shift and other jobs.

Suggested tech
Oneway suggests the first tech who's on shift and free for the window. Send them in one click.

Dispatch board
Each tech's shift and jobs in order, plus jobs still waiting for a tech.

Dispatch on a map

Planned

The board: today's jobs, jobs waiting for a tech, visits due and agreements ending.

Your techs' day, on their phones.

My day

Start and finish jobs

Customer sign-off
The customer signs on the tech's phone, with their typed name and the time.

Estimates and invoice amounts
Record estimate and invoice amounts on the job. Oneway doesn't charge cards.

On my way
The tech taps On my way, the board updates, and the customer is notified in the App.

Price book
Your line items and good, better, best options. What the customer picks becomes the estimate and invoice.

Follow-ups

Equipment and agreements

Equipment history and service agreements.

Customer equipment
Make, model, serial, install year, refrigerant, tonnage and warranty.

Service history
Each job shows the unit's full service history.

Service agreements
The plan, its yearly value, term, visits and covered units.

Automatic visit booking
Visits that are due show on the board and are booked as maintenance jobs.

Renewals
See agreements ending in the next 60 days and renew them from the day they end.

Recurring billing
Bill agreements automatically.
Planned

From the call to the next visit.

A call comes in
The customer, the address, the problem.

A tech is sent
In a window that fits their shift.

The job is done
The fix is saved to the unit's history.

The next visit
Booked from the agreement, renewed on time.

One truck today, a fleet later.

## Oneway Inventory Management

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/inventory

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Inventory Management
Core System

Inventory Management.

Oneway Inventory tracks your stock, purchase orders, sales and deliveries, so you always have the right amount of everything in the right place.

Replaces MarketMan or Restaurant365.

Plus what they can't do, because it's connected to the rest of your business.

Recipes that take stock
When a dish sells on Square, its ingredients are taken out of inventory.

Parts for repairs
Parts for a repair are set aside until the job is done, and their cost goes on the repair.

Stock and equipment together
Your stock and your equipment are tracked in one place.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Inventory Management in Oneway OS, with sample records.

Stock levels

Know what you have, everywhere.

Items, packs and variants
Each item with its unit, pack sizes, SKU and barcode. Sizes and colors are counted separately.

By location and shelf
See exactly where stock is, in every storage area and location.

Stock counts
Count a whole area or item by item. Differences show right away and an owner approves them.

Waste tracking
Log spoiled, damaged, expired, lost or comped items, with the dollar cost.

Full history
Every change is recorded. Quantities are never just overwritten.

Lots and expiration dates
Track each delivery's lot and expiration date. The oldest is used first, and you see what expires this week.

Count by scanning
Count an area on one screen with a barcode scanner or your phone's camera, and print labels.

Every item on the map by location, with its own history.

Orders and deliveries

Reorder before you run out.

Par and reorder points
Set them per location or for the whole business. Owners get one alert when stock runs low.

Demand forecast
See when each item will run out at the current pace, and when to reorder.

Purchase orders drafted for you
Low items are added to each supplier's order, filled back to par and rounded to full packs.

Approvals
An owner approves each order and marks it sent. Open orders stay listed until they arrive.

Receiving
Receive all or part of an order at the invoice cost, and see what never showed up.

Supplier performance
Promised vs. actual lead times, fill rate and on-time deliveries for each supplier.

Late deliveries
See which orders are due and which are late, with late ones at the top.

Sending orders to suppliers
Send purchase orders by email or PDF.
Planned

Sales

Sales update your stock.

Sales from Square
Square sales reduce stock by SKU, line by line.

Online and pickup orders
Stock is set aside while an order is open and deducted when it's paid or picked up.

Sold out everywhere
When a product hits zero it shows Sold out in your Shop and the App, and comes back when you restock.

Other points of sale
Shopify POS, Clover, Toast and Lightspeed sales updating stock.
Planned

Recipes and food cost
Selling a dish deducts its ingredients. See each dish's cost from your invoices and its food cost percentage.

Products for sale
Sell an item in your Shop and the App. It stays hidden until you publish it.

Across places

Every location, one system.

Transfers
Move stock between locations and shelves in one step.

Between properties
Send stock to another property you own. It's matched there by SKU.

All properties at a glance
Stock on hand, low items and open orders for every property, side by side.

What to move where
See each item by location, with suggested transfers when one place is short and another has extra.

Parts used on repairs
The cost of parts goes on the repair and on the equipment it fixed.

Installed parts
Follow each part from stock to installed, removed, repaired or thrown out.

Transfers suggested across properties
Extra stock at one property suggested where another is running low.
Planned

How it works

From order to sale.

Order
Before you run out, from the supplier, approved by an owner.

Receive
Checked against the order at the invoice cost.

Store
On a shelf, counted when you count, moved where it's needed.

Sell or use
In a sale, by a department or on a repair, then reorder.

Who it is for

For any business that keeps stock.

Hotels
Linens, amenities and maintenance parts.

Restaurants and bars
Food and drink, counted and costed.

Shops
What you sell and what's left.

Service companies
The parts on every truck.

At a glance

Oneway Inventory Management, in facts.

## Oneway Maintenance

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/maintenance

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Maintenance
Module

Maintenance.

Oneway Maintenance turns every reported problem into a work order, keeps preventive maintenance on schedule, and shows what each repair cost.

Replaces UpKeep or Limble.

Plus what they can't do, because it's connected to the rest of your business.

Repair history on every item
Every repair is logged on the equipment it fixed, so you see downtime and total cost per item.

Guests report problems in the App
Guests and members report a problem with a photo right from the Oneway App.

Parts from your stock
Parts for a job are set aside from inventory and used when the work is done.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta.

Talk to us

Maintenance in Oneway OS, with sample records.

Work orders

Every problem becomes a work order.

Create, assign, close
Create a work order, assign it (the person is notified), and close it with the fix, cost, parts, hours and photos.

Priority
Low, medium or high, sorted in the queue.

On hold
Mark jobs waiting on a part or vendor so they don't look in progress.

Work board
Drag jobs between To do, Started and On hold.

Requests from the App
Guests, members and staff report problems with a photo from the Oneway App, and get updates.

Checklists
Add checklist steps to a job. It can't be marked done until every step is checked.

The work board: to do, started and on hold.

Upkeep

Fix it before it breaks.

Preventive maintenance by date
Schedule jobs every so many days, with lead time so they don't pile up, and track on-time completion.

Preventive maintenance by usage
Schedule jobs by hours or uses, from manual readings or the equipment's sensors.

Inspections
Run inspection checklists, including lease inspections.

Repeat problems
When the same equipment keeps failing, it's grouped as one incident with what fixed it last time.

Who does it

Your team, vendors and parts.

Tech app
Techs see their jobs, tap Start and Done, log the fix, hours and photos, and keep working offline.

Vendors
Send a job to a vendor with a not-to-exceed amount and a private link. They accept or decline and close it with the cost.

Reserved parts
Parts are held in inventory for the job, used when it's done, and released if it's canceled.

Parts from inventory
Parts used are taken from stock and their cost is added to the repair.

Escalation
Jobs nobody picks up are escalated using rules you set.

Labor hours
Hours are filled in from Start to Done, to the quarter hour, unless entered by hand. The clock pauses while a job is on hold.

Failure reasons
Record why it broke when the job is done. It's saved on the equipment and counted in reports.

How it works

From reported to fixed.

Reported
From the App, the desk or a schedule.

Assigned
To a person or vendor, who's notified.

Done
What fixed it, the parts, the hours and the cost.

Tracked
Downtime and repeat failures for each item.

Who it is for

Anyone who keeps a building running.

Hotels
Rooms, the boiler, the elevators and the pool.

Rental property
Units and the tenants' requests.

Restaurants
Kitchen equipment.

Venues and clubs
Everything you need working on a busy night.

Comes with these Systems

Oneway Hotel Operations
Property Management System

At a glance

Oneway Maintenance, in facts.

What it is Oneway Maintenance turns every reported problem into a work order, keeps preventive maintenance on schedule, and shows what each repair cost.
Part of Oneway OS, as a module of Business OS.
Comes with Hotel Operations System, Property Management System.
Where it runs In Oneway OS, in a web browser on a computer or a phone.
Price Part of Business OS, set up by contact. See its plan ; Oneway OS alone is free.
Status In the Closed Selective Server Beta, by invitation, in New York City and Long Island.
Made by Oneway Technologies LLC, New York.

One photo cropped for the App, stories, Instagram, Facebook, link previews, Google and email.

Post everywhere at once
Write one post and it goes to the App, the web and every platform you've connected, formatted for each.

Campaigns from your events and offers
Pick an event or offer and Oneway schedules its posts, like a reminder the day before an event, and can stop them any time.

A marketing calendar
Every scheduled and published post for the month, in one calendar.

Posts that stay accurate
If an event moves or an offer changes, the posts that are now wrong are flagged and redrafted when you say so.

Approval before posting
A teammate's campaign waits as drafts until an owner or admin approves it. You can require approval for every campaign.

Post results
See how many times each post's link was opened and from where, how many RSVPs it brought, and how many came. It never tracks who opened it.

Results from Facebook and Instagram
See each campaign post's likes, comments, shares, saves and reach on Facebook and Instagram when you ask, next to its response in the App.

Best time to post
Campaign posts go out at the time of day your own posts get the most response, once there are enough posts to tell.

Email campaigns
Send an offer to a list of customers.
Planned

Create ads
Create and pay for ads from Oneway.
Planned

The difference

Your info, right everywhere.

Most marketing tools keep their own copy of your business. Oneway uses your one record.

Update once
Change your hours or an offer once, and it changes everywhere it's shown.

Catch what's out of date
See which places online still show old hours or info.

Photos that fit
Each photo is cropped around its subject for every platform, and your original is kept.

How it works

Update once, show everywhere.

Enter it once
Your info, offers and events.

Format it
Photos sized for each platform.

Send it out
The App, the web and each connected platform.

Check it
See where it went out and where it didn't.

Who it is for

Any business that wants to be found.

Hotels
Packages, events and weekly rates.

Restaurants
Specials, hours and live music.

Venues
Every show, everywhere.

Shops
What is new and what is on sale.

Comes with these Systems

Oneway Events
Restaurant Operations System

Oneway Marketing, in facts.

What it is Oneway Marketing creates your offers and posts, sizes each photo for every platform, schedules campaigns, and shows you where your business info is out of date online.

Reservations.

Oneway Reservations lets people book the things your place offers, a room, a table, a court or a space, from the Oneway App, and runs the book from confirmation to check-out.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Reservations in Oneway OS, with sample records.

What is booked

Make anything bookable.

Bookable items
Rooms, tables, courts, boats or event spaces. Anything you own can take bookings.

Booking hours

Who can book
Open to anyone or members only, item by item.

Availability

Booking grid

Planned

What can be booked, with its hours and rules.

Booking

Bookings from the App, all in one place.

Guest cancellations

Bookings list

Confirm, check in, check out

Empty time flagged

Rewards & Membership.

Oneway Rewards runs your loyalty program: members earn credits for what they do at your place, move up tiers, and redeem what they have earned.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Rewards & Membership in Oneway OS, with sample records.

The program

Your program, your rules.

Tiers and benefits

Earn credits
Members earn credits for stays, meals or visits.

Redeem credits
Members spend credits with you, tracked on their card.

Expiring credits
Credits expire after the period you set. An owner reviews each expiration run first.

Adjustments
Correct a member's balance and keep the reason.

The program's tiers, and its members.

Members

Members and cards.

Easy enrollment
Enroll from a customer profile, a Oneway account or just a name, or let people join in the App.

Card in the App
Members see their card in the App and choose what they share.

Cards from other programs
Members link cards they already have from other programs, confirmed by the provider's records.

Honor other programs
Choose which other programs' status you honor, and at what level.

Works with casino loyalty systems
If your casino already runs its own loyalty system, Oneway records what it reports and leaves the program to it.

Offers to a tier

Planned

No extra app to download.

In the App

Members choose

Other programs welcome
Link a card from another program without copying its data.

Enroll
At the desk, from the CRM, or in the App.

Earn
Credits for stays, meals and visits.

Move up
Higher tiers, better perks.

Redeem
Spend credits with you.

Members and their status.

## Oneway Scheduling

Source: https://onewayos.com/systems/scheduling

Our Mission App OS Security Contact

Sign in

Oneway OS › Business OS › Scheduling
Module

Scheduling.

Oneway Scheduling builds your weekly schedule, lets staff swap shifts and request time off from their phones, and tracks hours and labor cost.

Replaces 7shifts or Homebase.

Plus what they can't do, because it's connected to the rest of your business.

Labor cost vs. sales
See labor as a percent of sales, using the sales your POS already sends to Oneway.

Staffing based on bookings
Schedule the right number of people each day, based on your reservations and events.

One staff list
Your staff and their roles live in one place, with no separate employee list to keep up.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta.

Talk to us

Scheduling in Oneway OS, with sample records.

The week

Build and publish the week.

Shifts by role
Set each shift's hours and role, and edit freely until you publish.

Open shifts
Post a shift with nobody on it and let qualified staff claim it.

Publishing
Once published, each person sees their own schedule.

Availability
Staff set when they can work.

Copy last week
Copy a week's shifts into next week as drafts.

Shift reminders
Staff get a reminder within two hours before their shift.

Auto-fill open shifts
Open shifts go to the first person who's free, rested, available and under overtime.

The week, shift by shift, including open shifts.

The team

Swaps and time off, approved by a manager.

Shift swaps
Staff can give away or swap shifts, and a manager approves the change.

Cancel a shift
Cancel a published shift and the person is notified.

Time off requests
Staff request time off, a manager decides, and approved time off is blocked from the schedule.

Team notes
Post a note to the team and see who's read it.

Who's working
See everyone on shift right now.

Time and cost

Hours and labor cost.

Time clock
Staff clock in and out. Managers can fix or void a punch, and it's logged.

Timesheet approval
Managers approve each week's hours.

Pay rates
Set each person's hourly rate and when it starts. Only owners can change it.

Labor cost vs. sales
Daily and weekly labor cost, and labor as a percent of sales.

Staffing to demand
Compare how many people you've scheduled with how many your bookings, events and forecast sales call for.

Payroll export
Export hours, overtime, rates and cost per person as a spreadsheet for your payroll provider.

Location check at clock-in
Optionally require staff to be on site to clock in. Their location is never stored.

How it works

How a week works.

Build the week
Add shifts by role and leave some open.

Publish it
Everyone sees their own schedule.

The team adjusts
Claims, swaps and time off, approved by a manager.

Track hours and cost
Hours clocked, approved and compared to sales.

Who it is for

For any team that works shifts.

Hotels
Front desk, housekeeping and maintenance, around the clock.

Restaurants and bars
Front and back of house, scheduled against sales.

Venues
The crew each event needs.

Shops and services
Every opening hour covered.

At a glance

Oneway Scheduling, in facts.

What it is Oneway Scheduling builds your weekly schedule, lets staff swap shifts and request time off from their phones, and tracks hours and labor cost.
Part of Oneway OS, as a module of Business OS.
Where it runs In Oneway OS, in a web browser on a computer or a phone.

Team.

Oneway Team keeps who works at your business, what each of them may see and do, and every permit and license before it lapses.

Part of Business OS, by contact, in the Closed Selective Server Beta. What is still being built is marked Planned.

Talk to us

Team in Oneway OS, with sample records.

Roles

Roles and permissions.

Custom roles
Create roles that control which Systems, departments and actions each person can use.

Role assignment
Give each person a role. If they try something outside it, they're told why it's blocked.

Work kept separate
Someone's work for your business is kept separate from their personal account activity.

Onboarding checklists
A checklist of a new hire's first steps.
Planned

Permits and licenses, each with its expiration date.

Permits

Never miss a permit renewal.

Permits and licenses
Track each one's issuer, holder, number and expiration date.

Renewal reminders
Owners and admins are reminded 60, 30 and 7 days before it expires.

Expired permits flagged
Shown on your Oneway OS home screen until it's renewed.

Their time

Schedules and hours.

Each person's week
Shifts, time off and clock-ins, from Scheduling.

Payroll
Run payroll through a payroll provider.
Planned

The difference

One account per person.

Most HR tools keep a separate copy of each employee. In Oneway, each person has one account across everything.

Their own account
One Oneway account, with work kept separate.

Clear permissions
If something's outside their role, they're told plainly.

The same team everywhere
Scheduling, Maintenance and the inbox all use the same team list.

With a role.

They see their work
Only what their role allows.

Track permits
With renewal reminders.

Run the week
With Scheduling.
